chapter_title: Concerning the Wheel that exists in front of the K

1.original: [of the King of Honour who dwells in]
1.content: of the King of Honour who dwells in

spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

**¶1:** [Agai]n the [GAP-1: divine ordering principle —] the universal law of providence that stands before [GAP-2: divine wisdom governing from] the inmost celestial state [GAP-3: constraining] the origin of all ruling evils above and below in a great and unyielding bond of divine order; for the entire will of the great Divine Wisdom is placed in [GAP-4: this providential arrangement]. Also, the entire enmity of those ruling evils, which pervades the ordered heavens, is [GAP-5: held fast] and ensnared within it.

**¶2:** It exists in a radiance of divine truth [GAP-6: together with] the harmony and perfection of ordered goods and truths. Now, there are twelve confirmations of divine truth within it — the fullness of all governing verities. The confirming truth standing between each ordered heaven and the ruling evils dwelling there [GAP-7: binds them so that they] are held within it; for should any one of them seek to break free from divine order, it will be restrained [GAP-8: by that truth]. If it should seek to practice deception against its bond, [GAP-9: the falsification will be] made manifest and known in [GAP-10: that] law of providence [GAP-11: at once]. The ordered states of spiritual life, the knowledges of truth and good, and [GAP-12: the] governing principle of all spiritual powers exist there, and can be discerned through it, before the sight of Divine Wisdom.

**¶3:** The twelfth confirming truth within it is the fivefold perception of interior light — those five modes of spiritual apprehension that are conjoined and interwoven throughout the entire extent of the spiritual world; because every state where they are constrained, and every state where they have freedom, is displayed by that providential order. For the origin of all the ordered heavens above and below, and that of their ruling evils, is ensnared and fixed within it.

**¶4:** The vigilance of divine providence [GAP-13: over all states] is set perpetually before the great Divine Wis[GAP-14: dom governing all things,] so that the awe wh[GAP-15: ich divine order inspires] shall subdue all the powers of commingled good and evil, [GAP-16: keeping] their origin affixed there, so that they cannot make an escape from the bond of their constraint under divine law.

**¶5:** That providential order resem[b]les, in this respect, a connected series of binding truths held before the chief guardian of order, for when [GAP-17: any evil seeks to act] in th[GAP-18: ose states, it is held fast] in the [GAP-19: binding series of connected] truths.

**¶6:** This is also the case for all the ruling evils that dwell in the ordered heavens, and every power throughout the spiritual world: if they should seek to break free, they shall be recognized and laid bare by that providential order. [GAP-20: For] that order is like a great mirror of perfect discernment, reflecting all spiritual states — [the perception] of all things [GAP-21: whatsoever] is contained in it.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: [Agai]n the [Enlightener speaks concerning] the wheel that exists in front [of the King of Honour who dwells in] the seventh firmament [constraining], the root of the rulers above and below in a great and cruel fetter; as the entire will of the great King of Honour is placed in [it]. Also, their entire enmity, which is in the firmaments, is [bound] and ensnared in it.

It exists in a blaze of splendour [with] ornamentation and great beauty. Now, there are twelve seals in it. The seal between i[s] every firmament and the rulers who are there [are bound and ensnared, so that they] are in it; for should one of them wish to escape, he will be bound [by that seal]. If he should wish to cause a trick in his bond [it will be] apparent and known in [that] wheel [at once]. The spheres and stars and [the] leader of all the powers exist there, and can be known by it, in front of the King of Honour.

The twelf[t]h seal that is in it is its five shining men that are conjoined and enmeshed through the entire zone; because every place where they are cramped, and every place where they have space, is displayed by that wheel. For the root of all the firmaments above and below, and that of their rulers, is ensnared and fixed in it.

The observation [of that wheel] is set right at all times opposite the great King o[f Honour who watches over all] so that fear, wh[ich is in it] will assume all the powers of mixture [and bind them, keeping] their root affixed there, so that they cannot make an esc[a]pe from the fetter of their bond.
That wheel rese[m]bles, in this respect, a chain in front of the chief guard, for when [one of them moves] in th[ose bonds, he is caught] in the [great cha]in.

This is also the case for all the rulers who are in the firmaments, and every power of the zone: If they should wish to escape, they shall be recognised and revealed by that wheel. [For] the wheel is like a great mirror, for [the di]scrimination of all things [whatsoever is] in it.

fills.explanation: Standard Kephalaia chapter opening formula: "Again the Enlightener speaks concerning [topic]" introduces the subject of the wheel as the divine ordering principle.

fills.fill: of the King of Honour who dwells in
fills.original: of the King of Honour who dwells in
fills.explanation: The editor's fill correctly identifies the King of Honour (Divine Wisdom) as dwelling in the seventh firmament (inmost celestial state), consistent with Manichaean cosmology and the spiritual reading.

The spiritual reading says "constraining the origin of all ruling evils"; as a participle, "constraining" connects the wheel's position before the King of Honour to its function of binding the root of the rulers in a fetter.
The editor's "it" correctly refers to the wheel as the providential arrangement in which the entire will of the King of Honour is placed, consistent with the spiritual reading.
Parallels "ensnared" in the same clause; the spiritual reading says "held fast," and "bound and ensnared" is a standard Kephalaia doublet for the constraint of evil powers by divine order.
The editor's "with" correctly links the wheel's radiance to its ornamentation and beauty, matching the spiritual reading's "together with" for the conjunction of divine truth and ordered goods.

fills.fill: are bound and ensnared, so that they
fills.explanation: The spiritual reading says "binds them so that they are held within it"; the seal between each firmament binds the rulers there, using the text's own doublet "bound and ensnared" from ¶1, with "so that they" bridging to "are in it."

The spiritual reading says "by that truth," and in the natural register of this passage, the twelve seals are the confirming truths that bind rulers; "by that seal" specifies the instrument of restraint.

The spiritual reading says "the falsification will be made manifest"; "it will be apparent" refers back to the trick/deception, with "it" as the natural pronoun for the attempted ruse that becomes visible in the wheel.
The editor's "that" is confirmed; the demonstrative "that wheel" is the standard reference throughout the chapter to the providential order being described.
The spiritual reading says "at once," indicating the immediacy of the wheel's detection; any deception is instantly known in the wheel, emphasizing the omniscience of providential order.
The editor's "the" is confirmed as the definite article before "leader of all the powers," consistent with the spiritual reading's "the governing principle of all spiritual powers."

The spiritual reading says "the vigilance of divine providence over all states"; in the natural register, "the observation of that wheel" identifies the wheel as the instrument of surveillance set before the King of Honour.

fills.fill: f Honour who watches over all
fills.explanation: The spiritual reading says "dom governing all things"; in the natural register, the King of Honour watches over all through the wheel, expressing his governance and omniscient surveillance.

The spiritual reading says "which divine order inspires"; in the natural register, the fear "which is in it" (i.e., which resides in the wheel) will subdue the powers of mixture, expressing the awe inherent in the providential order.

The spiritual reading says "keeping" for this gap; the natural register requires a bridge between "assume all the powers of mixture" and "their root affixed there," and "bind them, keeping" uses the chapter's binding vocabulary while introducing the participial "keeping."

The spiritual reading says "any evil seeks to act"; in the chain-before-a-guard metaphor, "one of them moves" describes a prisoner's action that alerts the guard, paralleling ¶2's "should one of them wish to escape."

The spiritual reading says "ose states, it is held fast"; in the natural register of the chain metaphor, "those bonds" are the fetters, and "he is caught" expresses the immediate detection and restraint of any prisoner who stirs.

The spiritual reading says "binding series of connected truths"; in the natural register, "the great chain" completes the metaphor of the wheel as an imposing chain before the chief guard, with "great" echoing the chapter's emphasis on the wheel's magnitude.

The spiritual reading says "For" indicating a causal/explanatory connection; "For the wheel is like a great mirror" provides the reason why rulers are recognized and revealed, rather than the comparative "As" suggested by the editor.

The spiritual reading says "whatsoever is contained in it"; "the discrimination of all things whatsoever is in it" expresses the wheel's total comprehensiveness as a mirror reflecting every spiritual state without exception.
